title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council suspending the application of the rules on the appointment of an authorised representative for extended producer responsibility for batteries and waste batteries and packaging and packaging waste - A10-0266/2026

triage.reason: The ENVI committee published its report on a proposal to suspend authorised-representative rules for packaging EPR, a concrete EU legislative step within the PPWR framework.

draft.summary: On 9 October 2026, the European Parliament Committee on the Environment, Public Health and Food Safety published a report on a proposal for a regulation suspending the application of the rules on the appointment of an authorised representative for extended producer responsibility for batteries and waste batteries and packaging and packaging waste. The rapporteur is Ingeborg Ter Laak.
draft.source_quote: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council suspending the application of the rules on the appointment of an authorised representative for extended producer responsibility for batteries and waste batteries and packaging and packaging waste - A10-0266/2026
draft.interpretation: If adopted, the proposed suspension could temporarily relieve packaging producers of authorised-representative obligations under extended producer responsibility.
